description: On-chain agent bounty marketplace on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30). An admin initialises a marketplace PDA (seeds ["marketplace"]). Later instructions create SPL-escrowed bounties, claim and review them; those were not exercised in this run.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/forge-agent-bounty fork. The lab only changed declare_id to the Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset covering the verified initialize instruction; discriminators were confirmed on-chain. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/forge-agent-bounty/
QA: devnet proof of initialize and a rejected second initialize
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise create_bounty with an SPL mint and escrow against the lab marketplace
